name: ILACHAT – AI Chatbot & Live Chat
author: ILACHAT Team

sections.description:
ILACHAT WordPress Plugin allows you to integrate the powerful ILACHAT AI chatbot and live chat functionality into your WordPress site. With this plugin, you can provide 24/7 automated support, engage with your visitors in real-time, and enhance customer satisfaction.

By connecting to your ILACHAT account, this plugin automatically adds the ILACHAT widget to your website, enabling seamless customer support and live chat functionality.

Features:
– AI-powered chatbot for automated support.
– Live chat for real-time customer engagement.
– Multilingual support to connect with a global audience.
– Easy setup and configuration.
– Customizable chat widget design.
– Analytics to track user interactions and performance.

Learn more at https://ila.chat.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from https://ila.chat or the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it directly via the WordPress Admin Plugins page.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to the ILACHAT settings page in your WordPress dashboard to connect your ILACHAT account.
  5. Customize the chat widget and start providing automated and live support.
sections.faq:
Do I need an ILACHAT account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active ILACHAT account. Sign up at https://ila.chat.

Can I customize the chatbot widget?

Yes, the plugin allows you to customize the chat widget’s appearance to match your website design.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, ILACHAT supports multiple languages to cater to a global audience.

Is ILACHAT secure?

Yes, ILACHAT ensures enterprise-grade security for all interactions and data.
